description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.accounting parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: check_accounting uses make_finding with the fingerprint omitted; Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE (known gap).
Python ints are unbounded and Rust uses checked i64 addition for counter sums.
A bool is not an int (bool, float, and negative int counter values are ignored per key).
